code: import axios from"axios";import{env}from"../config/env";import{getAuthToken}from"../../auth/model/authStorage";const baseURL=String(env.apiBaseUrl||"").replace(/\/+$/,"");export const axiosClient=axios.create({baseURL,timeout:15000,headers:{Accept:"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}});axiosClient.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const token=getAuthToken();if(typeof FormData!=="undefined"&&config.data instanceof FormData){config.headers=config.headers||{};delete config.headers["Content-Type"];}if(token){config.headers=config.headers||{};config.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(token);}return config;});
